sections.title: Responsible for the content
body: {{operator}}, privately operated. The app “{{app}}” is a non-commercial service for the roundnet community.

sections.title: Dispute resolution
body: I am neither willing nor obliged to take part in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board.

sections.title: 2. Data we process
body: Account: first and last name, display name, email address and a password (stored as a hash only). Optional: profile picture and language.
Usage: group memberships, RSVPs to events, comments, drink and payment entries, game results and rankings, optionally a link to your Playerzone profile.
Device data: if you allow push notifications, we store the technical address of your device or browser at its push service.
Technical data: IP address, time and browser/device information appear in server logs. On errors, technical error reports are sent without your name and email address, but with your account ID.

sections.title: 3. Purposes and legal bases
body: Providing the app, account and group management, organizing events: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (contract of use).
Security, error analysis and stability: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest).
Push notifications and location access: Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent). You can withdraw it at any time in your device or browser settings and in your profile.

sections.title: 4. Visibility to other members
body: Members of your groups see your display name, profile picture, RSVPs, comments and game results. You can report comments and content at any time; group managers can remove content.

sections.title: 5. Location
body: The app only asks for your location when you use the map and have allowed access. The location is used on your device to show it on the map and is not stored on our servers.

sections.title: 6. Recipients and service providers
body: Supabase (database, authentication, file storage, server functions): stores all account and usage data on our behalf.
Google Firebase Hosting: delivery of the web app and static pages.
Sentry: error monitoring (without name and email address).
OpenStreetMap tile servers: when a map is shown, your IP address is transmitted to the map provider.
Push services of Apple, Google or your browser vendor: delivery of notifications.
Playerzone (Roundnet Germany): if you add a Playerzone link, we retrieve the profile data publicly visible there.
Where providers process data in third countries (e.g. the USA), this is based on standard contractual clauses or an adequacy decision.

sections.title: 7. Retention
body: We keep your data as long as your account exists. When you delete your account, name, email address, profile picture, push addresses, group memberships and RSVPs to upcoming events are removed. Game results and comments remain without personal reference (“Deleted user”) so rankings and discussions stay consistent.

sections.title: 8. Deleting your account
body: You can delete your account at any time in the app under Profile → Account → “Delete account”. The steps are also listed on the “Delete account” page of this website.

sections.title: 9. Your rights
body: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection (Art. 15–21 GDPR). Please use the contact address above.

sections.title: 10. Right to lodge a complaint
body: You can complain to a data protection supervisory authority, e.g. the Bavarian State Office for Data Protection Supervision (BayLDA), Promenade 18, 91522 Ansbach, Germany.

sections.title: In the app
body: 1. Sign in to “{{app}}”.
2. Open your profile and choose the “Account” tab.
3. Tap “Delete account” and confirm with your password.

sections.title: What is deleted
body: Name, email address, profile picture, push addresses, group memberships and RSVPs to upcoming events. You can no longer sign in afterwards.

sections.title: What is kept
body: Game results and comments remain without your name (“Deleted user”) so rankings and discussions stay complete for other members.

sections.title: No access to the app any more?
body: Write to the contact address in the imprint. We will delete your account after verifying your identity.

sections.title: 1. Scope
body: These terms apply to the use of the app “{{app}}”, a free community service of {{operator}} for organising roundnet events, games and drinks.

sections.title: 2. Your account
body: Provide correct information, keep your password secret and do not share your account. You can delete your account at any time in your profile.

sections.title: 3. No tolerance for objectionable content
body: Comments and other content must be respectful. It is not allowed to post content that is unlawful, harassing, threatening, hateful, discriminatory, sexually explicit, deceptive, spam, or that impersonates others.

sections.title: 4. Reporting and blocking
body: Every comment has a “Report” and a “Block” action. Reports are reviewed by moderators, usually within 24 hours. Content that breaks these rules is removed.
If you block a user, their comments are hidden for you. You can undo this in your profile at any time.

sections.title: 5. Consequences
body: Content that breaks these rules is removed. Users who repeatedly or severely break them can be removed from groups or have their account disabled, without prior notice.

sections.title: 6. Your content
body: You stay the owner of what you write. You allow the app to store it and show it to the members of the respective group for as long as it is needed to run the service.

sections.title: 7. Availability and liability
body: The service is provided free of charge and as available. Liability is limited to intent and gross negligence, except for injury to life, body or health and where the law requires otherwise.

sections.title: 8. Contact
body: Questions or complaints about content or these terms: see the contact details in the imprint.
